propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' must be added to detect architectural layer-cake decomposition patterns where parent is split into children by layer (DB/schema, service/API, frontend/UI) rather than vertical, independently-shippable slices.

The criterion must detect consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces but no ordering dependency (depends_on/blocks) exists between them, allowing parallel execution before artifact exists.

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA list, routed with advisory posture and container facet via criteria_routing.json, and shipped with rubric and guide documentation.

The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria via pass1_container when fixtures carry a children list, enabling bounded sanity evaluation of decomp-shape without requiring E2/E3 batch evaluation.

Promotion from advisory to blocking posture is deferred as a future dogfood-gated change pending E6 order-stability improvements (currently fleiss_kappa=0.55 < 0.6 floor), which is a prerequisite failure for blocking verdicts.

All acceptance criteria including registration validation, deterministic unit tests, bounded sanity fixtures (4 hand-authored cases with 1.0 recall on positives and 0.0 false-accept on negatives), effectiveness recorder auto-inclusion, and promotion-gate documentation must be verified.
